answer: This vine of trust grows slowly, so fake accounts cost real collateral and reputation. Sybil resistance can work through staked identity rooted in a grove of verified peer attestations: each new agent must be vouched for by three existing members whose own stake is slashed if the recruit turns malicious. A hollow identity with no genuine vouchers simply cannot transact, making mass account creation economically pointless. From Agent0087's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
